Summermyst - Enchantments of Skyrim.author: CegoPortsPSN
Summermyst - Enchantments of Skyrim.overview: Adds 109 new enchantments and integrates them into Skyrim's normal enchanted-item system while also revising many vanilla enchantments.
features: 65 new armor enchantments and 44 new weapon enchantments.
New enchantments can appear in merchant stock and normal loot, including equipment used by enemies.
The new effects can be disenchanted and applied to player equipment.
The listing also describes improvements and balance changes to existing vanilla enchantments.

Odin - Skyrim Magic Overhaul.author: CegoPortsPSN
Odin - Skyrim Magic Overhaul.overview: Rebalances and fixes vanilla magic, improves the usefulness of scrolls and staves, and adds 125 new lore-friendly spells with matching scrolls and staves.
features: Rebalances, fixes and improves vanilla spells.
Adds 125 new spells inspired by Elder Scrolls lore.
Adds corresponding scrolls and staves.
Integrates the added magic into normal loot and vendor inventories.
The listing says it is designed to work with popular magic-scaling mods and perk overhauls.

Mjolnir - Leviathan Axe - Blades of Chao.bethesdaTitle: Mjolnir - Leviathan Axe - Blades of Chaos ps5
Mjolnir - Leviathan Axe - Blades of Chao.author: Mors-Umbra
Mjolnir - Leviathan Axe - Blades of Chao.overview: Adds PlayStation versions of Mjolnir, the Leviathan Axe and the Blades of Chaos, using the weapon assets credited by the listing and a custom blazing recolor for the Blades.
features: The listing describes the weapons as high-quality God of War replicas with 4K textures.
Their weapon stats are set to the corresponding ebony mace, war axe and dagger tiers.
The PlayStation porter's note says the weapons must be crafted at a forge.
credits: Barraganchik is credited by the Bethesda listing for the original weapon assets.

Extended Encounters (SWF).author: FM07_2
Extended Encounters (SWF).overview: Adds additional random encounters to Skyrim's roads, wilderness and locations, including traveling NPCs, faction activity and events around dangerous places.
features: Adds road and wilderness encounters plus encounters tied to specific locations.
Adds traveling NPCs, adventurers and mercenaries, faction raids and other world events.
Includes a Mod Options Menu for enabling or disabling features.
The listing describes the implementation as lightweight and says it makes no vanilla reference changes.
requirements: Simple Workaround Framework is required for the Mod Options Menu described by the listing.

Vokriinator [EN].author: Morken_TV
Vokriinator [EN].overview: Combines selected Vokrii perks into Ordinator's larger perk trees to expand build options while retaining Ordinator's broad perk framework.
features: Adds selected Vokrii perks to Ordinator's perk trees.
Designed to increase build and playstyle variety without replacing Ordinator's larger trees.
The Bethesda listing describes a more extensive Vokriinator Black setup separately; this entry is the standard Vokriinator [EN] listing.
requirements: The Bethesda listing requires the English versions of Vokrii and Ordinator.

JaySerpa's Lines Expansion Bundle.author: CegoPorts
JaySerpa's Lines Expansion Bundle.overview: Bundles JaySerpa's dialogue and reaction expansions, adding roughly 3,000 lines that give NPCs more situational dialogue and reactions.
features: Includes dialogue expansions for bandits, the Civil War, carriages and stables, Forsworn and Thalmor, vampires, brawls and Dremora.
Includes NPC reactions to invisibility, necromancy and frenzy.
Includes Additional Healing Reactions and Immersive Rejections.
The Bethesda listing identifies the included components individually and credits JaySerpa and AndrealphusVIII.

Xavbio 1K Base + DLC.author: Ysmirs__Beard
Xavbio 1K Base + DLC.overview: Complete armors and weapons from the base game and DLC, plus clothing and unique armors and weapons, in full 1K–1K resolution. AE/CC content is a separate upload.
features: Covers base-game and DLC armors and weapons.
Includes clothing and unique armors and weapons.
Uses full 1K–1K resolution.
Anniversary Edition / Creation Club content is handled by the separate XAVBIO 1K AE/CC upload.
credits: The PlayStation Creations listing credits xavbio.
